headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat to be India's slowest
summary: The upcoming Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat service is set to become the slowest and longest-duration chair car train in the country. It will maintain an average speed of 54 kmph, trailing behind standard superfast trains.

headline: First UK charter flight brings 300 tourists to Goa
summary: Goa welcomed its first UK charter flight of the season, carrying around 300 tourists. This marks a significant boost for the state's international tourism sector.

headline: Goa college introduces 'marriage readiness' course
summary: A college in Goa has launched a specialized course aimed at preparing young adults for healthy and lasting marriages. The program focuses on helping couples better understand their partners.

headline: Retired pilot and judge conquer Goa Ironman 70.3
summary: A retired pilot and a Kerala High Court judge successfully completed the gruelling Goa Ironman 70.3 challenge. Participants from across regions tested their endurance in the demanding athletic event.

headline: Goa seeks Rs 1,000 crore for dam upgrades
summary: The Goa government has requested Rs 1,000 crore for crucial infrastructure upgrades at the Anjunem and Selaulim dams. The funds will be utilized to improve water management and safety.

headline: CM intervenes in Sanvordem mining dispute
summary: Goa's Chief Minister stepped in to resolve a transportation dispute regarding mining operations in Sanvordem. The intervention aims to balance industry demands and local concerns.

headline: Goa to showcase mining potential at meet
summary: The state government is set to highlight its mining potential and upcoming block auctions at an upcoming investment meet. Authorities plan to revise transportation and land right rates to encourage participation.

headline: Goa to move Supreme Court over ST reservation
summary: The Goa government has decided to approach the Supreme Court after a High Court order stalled the ST seat reservation process. Officials aim to clear legal hurdles before the 2027 polls.

headline: Data reveals status of deleted voters in Goa
summary: Recent inquiries shed light on the voter deletion numbers across different communities in Goa. Election authorities reported that the majority of removed voters are either shifted, untraceable, or disqualified.

headline: Goa adopts AI governance for public schemes
summary: The Goa government has signed an MoU with an American firm to integrate artificial intelligence into governance. The initiative aims to streamline the disbursement of public benefits and services.

headline: Court grants bail to Ugandan arrested with heroin
summary: A court in Goa has granted bail to a Ugandan national who was earlier arrested in connection with a drug seizure involving heroin. Legal proceedings in the case remain ongoing.

headline: Churchill aims to end losing run in football league
summary: Churchill Brothers are looking to break their recent losing streak as they prepare to face an in-form NorthEast side. The team aims for a tactical turnaround to secure vital points.

headline: Historic Panaji home blends heritage with spirituality
summary: A traditional residence in the heart of Goa's capital has caught attention for its unique architecture where every corner reflects deep cultural roots. The property stands out as a historic architectural gem.

headline: High Court scraps Bodgeshwar temple panel polls
summary: The High Court has intervened and cancelled the scheduled elections for the Bodgeshwar temple committee panel. The ruling addresses procedural grievances raised regarding the electoral process.

headline: Panchayats told to ban plastic in Narkasur effigies
summary: Local panchayats have been directed to strictly enforce a ban on the use of burning plastic in Narkasur effigies during celebrations. The measure is aimed at curbing environmental pollution and fire hazards.

headline: Crime branch police inspector held for sexual assault
summary: A suspended crime branch police inspector and a co-accused have been arrested for the alleged sexual assault of a 16-year-old minor. The case is being handled by the cyber crime division.

headline: CCTV catches crow causing major Salcete blackout
summary: A five-hour power blackout across Salcete and Kushavati districts was traced back to a crow, as captured by CCTV footage. The unusual incident caused significant disruption to local power grids.

headline: Rivar Group signs Rs 3,000 crore MoU with Goa
summary: The Rivar Group has signed an MoU worth Rs 3,000 crore with the Goa government to establish an International Sports & Performance City. The project is expected to boost sports infrastructure in the state.

headline: Goan filmmaker Aditya Jambhale to be felicitated at IFFI
summary: Three-time National Award-winning Goan filmmaker Aditya Jambhale will be honored at the upcoming International Film Festival of India (IFFI). He is being recognized for his notable contributions to cinema.

headline: Goa to auction more mining blocks by December
summary: The state government announced plans to auction 8 to 9 additional mining blocks by December. Show-cause notices have also been issued to non-operational leaseholders.

headline: Goa strengthens UK tourism push at WTM London
summary: Goa actively promoted its tourism sector and cultural offerings at the World Travel Market (WTM) in London. State representatives highlighted sustainable travel and new visitor attractions.

headline: Goa's GST collections jump 37%
summary: Goa recorded a robust 37% jump in its Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections, outpacing the national average. Officials attribute the surge to improved compliance and economic activity.

headline: Decomposed body of unidentified man found in Neura
summary: The decomposed body of an unidentified man was discovered in the backwaters of Neura. Local authorities have launched an investigation to determine the identity and cause of death.

headline: Twelve men run multi-crore scam from Goa villa
summary: Police uncovered a financial scam operated by twelve young men from a luxury villa in Goa. The elaborate fraud operation involved transactions worth crores before law enforcement stepped in.

headline: Goa adds five new polling booths in North district
summary: The number of polling stations in North Goa has increased with the addition of five new booths, bringing the district total to 1,735. The update aims to facilitate smoother voting access for residents.
